milestones.description: Uses position_inside_box because the player must physically walk ~8-10 blocks north from spawn into the forced stony_peaks biome zone. The biome starts at x+8, so the box requires the player to be at x>=8 which places them inside the mountains area. This is a navigation/movement task — the player must traverse from the grass spawn area into the stone mountain zone.

Uses inventory_has because mining gray concrete with a pickaxe drops the gray_concrete item which ends up in the player's inventory. The player must equip the iron pickaxe and break at least one of the 9 gray concrete blocks in the cluster at (+9 to +11, +3 to +4).

Uses inventory_has because crafting glass panes (6 glass in 3x2 pattern on crafting table) produces glass_pane items that go into the player's inventory. The player has 6 glass blocks and a crafting table is at (+9, 0, 0). The recipe yields 16 glass panes.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate/observe task — the player must navigate to and visually identify the oak pressure plate placed at (+10, 0, 0) in the mountains area. The target is the pressure plate's position, max_distance=5 ensures the player is close enough to see it, and facing_tolerance=60 ensures they are looking toward it (confirming they found it).
